body.notify: Extends Epic `add-daemon-driven-code-review-stage` (761a43a6) — Story B of the Fix-C pair (sibling of s9). Builds the diff-only degraded-review fallback on the s9 gate (src/mcp/code-review-step/handler.ts, src/workflow/code-review/{runner,grounding,types,subject}.ts) and folds in the working-tree-diff changedFiles fix surfaced by the s9 dogfood.

addedStory.title: Fall back to a diff-only degraded review when the index cannot be made fresh
addedStory.userValue: s9 currently FAILS CLOSED (returns 'review-declined', no verdict) when the user declines to wait for a fresh index at the confirm_wait/timeout prompt. This story replaces that dead-end with a DIFF-ONLY non-graph review pathway: instead of aborting, it reviews the raw changed-file diff directly (not the graph symbol summaries), so the user still gets a real review signal without waiting for indexing. The fallback record is tagged groundingMode:'degraded' (distinguishing it from s9's graph-grounded groundingMode:'full') and its computed verdict is CAPPED at warn — a diff-only review can never yield an overall 'pass', so it can never silently satisfy the codeReview.enforce completion gate; completing a Story on a degraded review always requires an explicit override. This story also FOLDS IN a distinct gap the s9 dogfood surfaced: resolveCodeReviewSubject derives changedFiles from the git WORKING-TREE diff, which is empty after a build→commit→review ordering, so a review finds nothing to judge regardless of index freshness (the actual dominant cause of the hollow PASS). The diff-only path must derive a NON-EMPTY changed set — falling back to the last commit's diff (git show HEAD) when the working tree is clean — so it has real content to review. Scope: the four-dimension judge vocabulary is reused where practical (a diff-scoped charge), the diff content is bounded structured hunks (not unbounded raw dumps), all model access stays through the LLMProvider abstraction (no cloud REST), and the review remains read-only over the code it judges.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the user declines to wait for a fresh index (proceed:false at the initial confirm_wait, or abort at a timeout re-prompt)
acceptanceCriteria.then: instead of failing closed with 'review-declined', it runs a diff-only review over the changed-file diff and produces a persisted code-review record

acceptanceCriteria.given: the working tree is clean (all of a Story's build changes are already committed) so the working-tree diff is empty
acceptanceCriteria.when: the diff-only path derives its changed set
acceptanceCriteria.then: it falls back to the last commit's diff (git show HEAD) so the review has a non-empty set of changed files + hunks to judge, rather than reviewing nothing
the record is tagged groundingMode:'degraded' (distinct from the graph-grounded groundingMode:'full')

acceptanceCriteria.given: a diff-only review's four-dimension findings would otherwise fold to a clean pass
acceptanceCriteria.then: the verdict is capped at warn — a degraded review can never register an overall 'pass'

acceptanceCriteria.given: codeReview.enforce is on and a Story's only code-review record is a groundingMode:'degraded' one (verdict warn)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the completion gate evaluates the Story
acceptanceCriteria.then: the degraded review does NOT satisfy the gate on its own — completion still requires an explicit override, exactly as a non-pass verdict does

acceptanceCriteria.given: the graph index IS fresh (s9's path)
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is unchanged — the full graph-grounded four-dimension review runs and stamps groundingMode:'full' with an uncapped verdict (the diff-only fallback is reached only on a decline)
